data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dorotea was a nymph, meaning ‘gift of God.’ In Christianity, Dorotea is the name of several saints, including a martyr who is venerated in the Eastern Orthodox Church and a disciple of Mary Magdalene. The name Doroteia carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Doroteia usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
